## Publication Information

**Date:** 1901

**Genre:** Non-fiction

**Publisher:** <i>Friendly Leaves</i> (May 1901) 171-3.

**Notes:** This series, 'Leaves for the Months', some of which are unsigned, is attributed to CMY in her obituary in <i>Friendly Leaves</i> (April 1901).
